messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — candidate for ML Infra slot moved to 4:30pm PT today (was 3pm). Need someone to cover the panel and own the debrief capture. Zoom room IRL-4.
Maya (People Ops): I can backfill the panel, but need clarity on scoring weights — are we counting the take-home?
Samir Patel: +1 to Maya covering. I can consolidate notes into the hiring sheet. Do we keep the 24h async debrief window?
Priya Nair: Yes keep 24h async window. Take-home should be included as an "implementation" bucket. Proposal: implementation 20%, code/problem solving 35%, system/design 25%, behavior 20%. Thoughts?
Alex Cho: I can own score normalization across interviewers. Quick Q: do we allow +/− penalities for late submits in window?
Maya (People Ops): I wouldn't penalize for being within 24h, only flag if >24h. Also confirm candidate consent to recording — @Samir can you ping them?
Samir Patel: Pinged candidate via email — they consented to recording and ASR.
Interviews Bot: Reminder: submit eval form within 24h: https://company.forms/evals/ML-INFRA-2026
Interviews Bot: ```Eval highlights:
- Implementation (20)
- Code/problem solving (35)
- System design (25)
- Behavioral (20)
- Freeform notes (required)```
Alex Cho: I'll create the scribe doc and add a normalization cell. Formula I'll use to z-score then convert to 0-100: normalized = round(((raw - avg)/stdev) * 10 + 50, 1) — will paste spreadsheet cell formula in doc.
Priya Nair: Awesome. @Maya can you be debrief owner (scribe + drop summary row)? If you can't, Samir will do it.
Maya (People Ops): I got it. I'll scribe and publish summary row + pass the doc to Alex for normalization. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Thanks all — final asks: add any tilt/context (timezones, take-home vs live weighting) at top of doc; if anything unexpected happens escalate in #people-ops.
Alex Cho: Noted, I will add an "assumptions" header and the normalization tab.
Samir Patel: I'll upload the recording link and transcript to the doc after the session.
Priya Nair: Perfect. See you all in IRL-4, 4:30pm PT.
